blockingFindings.description: The crouch and sit previews show the new lower-rise textile bridge without an obvious skin-through opening from these camera views. This is a visual observation of V14 only; no side-by-side comparative gain, clearance, strain, boundary coverage from other angles, or pose acceptance is claimed. Shorts fit remains unverified.
Back, crouch and sit renders still show an angular raised rear block and narrow pointed cloth tails under the seat. Silhouette and pose deformation remain rejected.
Front, side, arms-up and arm-cross renders still show triangular faceting across sleeves, shoulders, side torso and waist. Surface quality is rejected.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
